title: AI Agents Made Science Code 60x Faster Then Broke The Math
description:
AI agents made a DNA sequencing program 60x faster. Another one, nearly 100x on a key step 🔥

But on the third project the agent mixed up parameters. Code ran fine, looked convincing, and gave the wrong answer 😅

So the split is clear: rewriting and optimizing, agents handle that. Judging if the science underneath is correct they dont. Fast result still needs an expert ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
